protocol.loss: Equal-patch channel-scaled RMSE; fit regimes sampled uniformly
protocol.selection: Calibration State every four epochs; architecture/blend chosen on calibration only
protocol.labels: All fit dates of public train available to both neural methods and full-label LGB; sampled patches repeat targets.
protocol.matched_ablation: Same patch RNG, width, optimizer and training budget; geometry graph control lacks adaptive attention
protocol.independent_implementation: FD geometry conditioning and topology relation biases; no third-party source, weights or predictions
protocol.assessment_status: Previously inspected public-train development dates; not an untouched final test

source_snapshot.scope: Own source, vendored official Python and dependency locks; no data, credentials or model weights

source.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model

source_at_start.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source_at_start.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

paired_daily_interval.note: Day-mean diagnostic, not a confidence interval for Kaggle score.

source_at_end.peak_scope: current process lifetime, not isolated per model
source_at_end.source_fingerprint_scope: On-disk source at evidence() call; a captured start archive is primary when present

limitations: One direction/fold/fit seed. All assessments are already-inspected public-train development dates. Adaptive-attention comparison controls neural optimization budget; full LGB has the same available label dates, not the same repeated patch count. No hidden labels or boundary flux.
